description: What replaces each piece of Angular Material, MUI, Bootstrap, Ant Design, Chakra, React Bootstrap or PrimeNG in this design system, in the project's framework. Call before migrating code that uses one of those libraries; keep behaviour identical and use get_component_docs for props and events.

framework.description: The project's UI framework (from its package.json: @angular/core → angular, vue → vue, svelte → svelte, solid-js → solid, react → react). Defaults to the one set for this connection.

name: get_migration_map
title: Map another UI library to the design system
